THE ₱3B "SURPLUS" POSTS ARE NOT ACCURATE... I appreciate the posts and all of the kind words, but let's clarify... At kunin na rin natin ang pagkakataon para pag-usapan ang topic na 'to:

Government "SURPLUS" or "SAVINGS" is NOT an accomplishment. ❌ Hindi dapat nag-iimbak ng pera ang gobyerno, dapat nilalabas ito para tulungan ang mga tao at para palaguin ang ekonomiya.

It is true that Pasig has had big "savings", but it's more important to understand WHY:

(1) Malaki ang natitipid dahil sa laban kontra korapsyon, lalo na sa procurement reform. To keep it short, the main reason is that because of TRUE OPEN BIDDING AND NO KICKBACKS, prices go down. What was previously 100M can now be done for 80 or even lower.

(2) HINDI PA 100% NA NAKAKASABAY ang "ABSORPTIVE CAPACITY" ng LGU sa BIGLANG PAGLAKI NG BUDGET. Ang "absorptive capacity" ay ang kakayahan o limit ng LGU para gamitin ang pondo sa maayos na paraan. Our annual budget doubled in 5 years from around 10B to 20B. Our expenditures (social services, other services, salaries, and infra) have also almost doubled, but not quite (very rough estimate from 9B to 16B).

- A secondary factor here are the LONG-TERM REFORMS we have introduced, from planning to procurement to implementation. Madugo man ang mga pinakilalang pagbabago, ang resulta ay mas nakakasiguro tayo na magagamit ng tama ang ating pondo sa hinaharap.

NAGTATANIM TAYO NANG MAAYOS NGAYON PARA MAS GUMANDA PA ANG AANIHIN NATIN BUKAS.

Let's go Pasig! Let's continue to build on our wins!

#TuloyTuloyLang
#LocalGovernment
#PasigCity
#UmaagosAngPagasa 

–

[With regard to debt, to be fair to the previous local administration, we did not inherit debt in 2019. Income generation was always their priority, to the point that even traffic enforcers had quotas. Pasigueños may also remember the big tarps they posted thanking them for the 15B cash-in-bank they left behind... but of course this was misleading, since the 15B was mostly a combination of (1) Continuing Appropriations, (2) Accounts Payable, and (3) Savings due to most plantilla positions being left Vacant. But still, we give credit where credit is due.]

Sinulat ko na lahat para nasa publiko na ang impormason; para na rin may reference tayo. Konti lang naman siguro ang magbabasa nito hanggang dulo, pero kung umabot ka hanggang dito salamat you're the best.

From :Vico Sotto’s fb post
